scene: Your crackling spit shocks the dolphin fountain into spitting three shiny tokens.
picture: A flat side-view along the piazza edge. On the far left, a sleek hover metro car waits beside a low ramp. Left of centre, the silver-haired grandmother in her pink tracksuit holds her white dog on a leash beside the sparked dolphin fountain. In the centre sits a red double-decker hover bus, while a striped gondola drone floats on the far right.
